identity.promise: turn validated technical content into a polished technology product visual for covers and concepts, then a content-rich information design for precise diagrams

surface.background: fully opaque cool white technology canvas based on #F7FAFF
surface.grid: faint blue drafting grid based on #DCE8FA appears only in open background regions
surface.finish: clean luminous enterprise-technology editorial surface with subtle blue ambient depth and no paper texture

palette_roles.ink: deep navy based on #071A3D carries titles primary labels and hierarchy
palette_roles.primary: cobalt blue based on #1769FF carries primary structures arrows and emphasized words
palette_roles.secondary: bright cyan based on #18B9E8 supports transitions and selected secondary modules
palette_roles.success: teal green based on #20C997 appears only for validated success states
palette_roles.attention: warm amber based on #F5A000 appears only for validated human judgment warning or exception states
palette_roles.failure: clear red based on #F23D4F appears only for validated failure or blocked states
palette_roles.neutral: cool gray-blue based on #6E7F99 supports secondary copy dividers and inactive structure

material_and_texture.cover_material: polished glass-acrylic panels frosted glass capsules white satin device frames and translucent blue edges
material_and_texture.diagram_material: flat white cards with pale blue outlines minimal corner radius and almost no material rendering
material_and_texture.surface_detail: subtle glass refraction fine blue edge light soft interface highlights and clean anti-aliased icon surfaces
material_and_texture.finish: premium technology product visual rather than generic corporate clip art or dark cyberpunk art

line_language.primary: clean cobalt blue two-pixel system paths with compact arrowheads and generous bend radii
line_language.secondary: cool gray-blue one-pixel dividers grid lines and explanatory boundaries
line_language.semantic: green amber and red paths appear only when the validated graph assigns the matching state
line_language.icons: simple geometric device database shield package check warning and loop icons with consistent stroke and fill grammar

geometry.cover_composition: one hybrid 2.5D technology scene combines a dominant system panel or browser frame with one or two subordinate glass device or process objects
geometry.concept_composition: one polished modular technology explainer uses a clear focal module purposeful supporting modules and visible connection logic
geometry.diagram_composition: one flat infographic uses large rounded white containers grid-aligned modules generous spacing and content-rich information design with blank title and subtitle zones step markers caption rails group bands and explanatory strips
geometry.comparison_composition: a left-right comparison or before-to-after evolution may use two differently scaled system panels one large blue-to-green transition arrow circular technology icons and validated section headings
geometry.module_shape: rounded rectangles device frames glass capsules and restrained circular hubs use consistent corner radii
geometry.grid: a faint cool-blue construction grid gives technical order without turning the image into CAD
geometry.occupancy: content occupies roughly seventy-eight to eighty-eight percent of the frame while title and annotation zones remain deliberate

depth_and_camera.cover_depth: restrained front-facing 2.5D perspective with shallow device thickness and polished edge separation
depth_and_camera.concept_depth: mostly frontal with selective shallow extrusion or glass layering only when it improves hierarchy
depth_and_camera.diagram_depth: strict flat infographic with no perspective and no generated text
depth_and_camera.lighting: soft spatial shadow subtle blue ambient bounce and restrained glass highlights; no dramatic spotlight neon bloom or black background

typography.voice: bold modern sans-serif with deep navy hierarchy and selective cobalt emphasis
typography.title: large deterministic Chinese or English title overlay with compact subtitle optional uppercase eyebrow and blank title and subtitle zones reserved during image generation
typography.generated_text: image generation leaves title labels legends node names and status copy blank; deterministic text overlay supplies all exact wording
typography.annotation: deterministic annotation overlay uses short labels large enough for article and presentation width
typography.workflow: two-stage text workflow: imagegen creates a text-free image-generation background and a deterministic final overlay applies validated readable copy
typography.golden_copy: golden references include readable example copy so the finished title hierarchy node labels and explanatory text remain part of the style definition

semantic_color_policy.default: cobalt blue and navy carry the normal system
semantic_color_policy.exceptions: semantic state colors are evidence-bound: teal for success amber for judgment or warning red for failure and purple only for a validated distinct service class
semantic_color_policy.limit: never use semantic colors as decoration and never create an unsupported state

density_and_spacing.density: content-rich airy technology composition with one dominant panel or focal module purposeful supporting objects and information-design layers that never alter semantics
density_and_spacing.spacing: generous grid-aligned gaps separate title panel devices modules and semantic groups while keeping their relation visually continuous
density_and_spacing.occupancy: cover and concept content occupies roughly seventy-eight to eighty-eight percent; strict diagrams preserve every frozen-graph element inside a seventy-two-pixel safe margin

required_traits: cool white technology canvas faint blue drafting grid and navy information hierarchy establish a clean technical atmosphere
cobalt blue system logic polished glass-acrylic material and soft spatial shadow create premium technology product visual quality
cover and concept roles use deliberate shallow 2.5D depth while the diagram role remains a precise flat infographic with content-rich information design
semantic state colors appear only when supported and remain secondary to cobalt blue
deterministic text overlay and deterministic annotation overlay preserve exact Chinese English labels titles legends and states
two-stage text workflow combines a text-free image-generation background with a deterministic final overlay
golden references include readable example copy with large navy titles cobalt keyword emphasis compact English subtitles section pills node labels and explanatory text
the visual remains content-rich polished and legible at article width
forbidden_traits: no dark cyanotype black background or dark dashboard; no neon cyberpunk laser grid or luminous sci-fi tunnel
no generic stock-photo people office scene humanoid robot floating hologram or decorative AI brain
no dense glassmorphism dashboard chrome excessive blur giant empty card wall or mobile-app mockup with meaningless UI
no photoreal product advertisement chrome overload dramatic lens flare heavy bloom harsh cast shadow or candy-plastic toy rendering
no generated Chinese English labels titles legends node names dimensions or pseudo-technical text
no unsupported nodes edges devices states colors branches exceptions returns or topology

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 4 uses a cool white grid cobalt-blue product-technology system polished glass-acrylic devices and stronger modular UI framing; Style 1 uses warm ivory editorial space sparse connected mechanisms muted graphite contours and restrained red-cyan accents

Style 4 is cobalt-blue technology-forward with glass device depth semantic system colors and UI-like technical modules; Style 2 is white-green quiet editorial minimalism with large open space restrained green emphasis and almost no product-render material

Style 4 is front-facing white-blue interface and device composition with shallow glass depth; Style 5 uses a fixed 30-degree isometric camera matte infrastructure solids platform thickness environmental scale and directional shadows
